name: party-totals

reads.licence: Party donation returns filed under the Electoral Act 1993 and published by the Electoral Commission: public records

rules: a party-year with more than one return held is shown with every return and none is chosen
a figure read from pixels is marked as weaker evidence
known_limits: Only returns with a text layer are read; scanned returns wait for the page reader. Only the declaration page is read, so there are no donor rows. A figure is the party's own declared total as printed; a return whose total could not be reconciled with its own parts is left out and counted as set aside. Nothing before 2017.
